Welp, someone had to do it. Getting a copy of this vn was hard (nearly every link was dead) except for two that I happen to stumble upon. The game is completely untranslated and heavily region locked. In order to even run it, you need to obtain a Japanese windows iso and install it, no other way to my knowledge works. Once you get past that hurdle, you need to obtain a serial number key (Which I'll provide below) that [I got from here.](https://lah.li/23795/femshota-h-game-piko-to-chiko-shota-idol-no-oshigoto/?page=1) There is also a magnet link to a Japanese windows xp iso listed on that page you'll need or you can use [this win7 x32 jp iso.](https://archive.org/details/win-7-pro-sp-1-japanese-x32)

Serial number: 4192-7572-6735-7589

Enjoy
